title: North Pole Express Highland Park
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Celebrate the holiday season on the North Pole Express Highland Park tour, where the magic of Christmas comes alive through dazzling displays of lights. Take a leisurely journey through Dallas's most festive neighborhoods, marveling at beautifully decorated homes and unique light installations. An expert guide will share stories about the history and significance of the holiday traditions while you sip on warm cocoa. This family-friendly experience is perfect for creating cherished holiday memories with loved ones.

- Enjoy a festive tour showcasing Dallas's enchanting Christmas lights
- Guided journey through Highland Park’s most beautifully decorated homes
- Sip hot cocoa while soaking in the holiday spirit with family and friends
- Ideal for families looking to celebrate the season together
